question: What arrangement does the speaker promise to tell to the beloved one?
premises: The speaker promises to tell something.
That something is the arrangement of the row of yoginīs.
It is told to the beloved one.
inference: The speaker will tell the beloved one the arrangement of the row of yoginīs.
uncertainties: The details of that arrangement are not given in this verse.
plain_english: I shall tell you, O beloved one, the arrangement of the row of yoginīs.
